name: Export/Import Adjustments
description: Adjust project transfer export/import behavior for raw provenance settings, URL fidelity, omission diagnostics, and imported provider/model snapshots.

userStories.title: Add raw article provenance export mode to the backend contract
userStories.description: As a project transfer operator, I want raw article provenance export behavior to be selectable so that I can choose package size versus fidelity intentionally.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a `rawArticleProvenanceMode` export option with `auto`, `include`, and `omit` values to the project-transfer export request and thread it through the export service and export context assembly.

`auto` preserves the current threshold-driven behavior, `include` forces raw provenance JSON fields into the package even above the current threshold, and `omit` forces those raw provenance fields out of the package regardless of estimate.
Export warnings and serialized payloads reflect the selected mode instead of only the current hardcoded threshold path.
bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferExport.test.ts passes
bun test src/server/routes/projectTransferRoutes.test.ts passes
bun run build passes

userStories.title: Preserve non-local URLs unchanged during export
userStories.description: As a project transfer operator, I want signed and credential-bearing URLs to survive export unchanged so that review inputs and source provenance are not silently rewritten.
acceptanceCriteria: Recognized non-local URLs remain byte-for-byte unchanged during export even when they contain credentials, signed query parameters, or fragments.
Generic secret-pattern redaction no longer re-catches parsed non-local URL strings after URL detection.
Export emits a non-redacting warning for credential-bearing or signed URLs without changing the payload value.
bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferRedaction.test.ts passes
bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferExport.test.ts passes
bun run build passes

userStories.title: Improve omission diagnostics and eliminate URL-driven omission cascades
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want omission warnings to identify the triggering row and field so that export fidelity problems are explainable and URL-only review inputs do not cascade into avoidable row loss.
acceptanceCriteria: Article and prompt omission warnings include the source row id, triggering field name, and omission reason in warning details.
Dependent omission warnings include the omitted parent reference and dependency reason in warning details.
Article titles or summaries that contain only recognized non-local URLs no longer trigger `decisionPayloadRowOmitted` or downstream dependent omission cascades.
Existing local-path, private-host, and non-URL secret cases still follow the intended omission or redaction path.
bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferRedaction.test.ts passes
bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferExport.test.ts passes
bun run build passes

userStories.title: Mark imported provider and model snapshots explicitly
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want imported provider and model snapshots to carry an explicit marker so that snapshot reuse never drifts back into remapping arbitrary local rows.
acceptanceCriteria: Imported provider snapshot rows persist an explicit imported-snapshot marker in `config_json` or an equivalent durable field.
Imported model snapshot rows persist an explicit imported-snapshot marker in model fields or metadata used during reuse lookup.
Reuse lookup code only considers rows carrying the imported-snapshot marker and ignores manual or discovered local provider/model rows.
bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferDependencyResolution.test.ts passes
bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferCommit.test.ts passes
bun run build passes

userStories.title: Add dedicated imported snapshot fingerprints
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want stronger imported snapshot fingerprints so that only request-equivalent provider and model snapshots are ever reused.
acceptanceCriteria: Add provider and model snapshot fingerprint helpers that include provider runtime-signature inputs plus the full model metadata needed for judgment request equivalence.
Fingerprint comparisons differ when model metadata changes `contextLimit`, `promptTokenLimit`, or `modelOptions`.
Snapshot reuse no longer relies on the current exported model `signature` alone.
bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferDependencyResolution.test.ts passes
bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferCommit.test.ts passes
bun run build passes

userStories.title: Resolve imported snapshots during analysis
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want dependency resolution and fidelity validation to target imported snapshots during analysis so that judgment planning works without rebinding to existing local models.
acceptanceCriteria: During analysis, source providers and models resolve to concrete existing imported snapshot ids when the imported-snapshot marker and fingerprint match exactly.
When no exact imported snapshot exists, analysis preserves virtual `new:provider:*` and `new:model:*` ids through target planning and fidelity validation.
Judgment reuse and conflict detection operate on these resolved or virtual imported ids without matching onto existing enabled local provider/model rows.
bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferDependencyResolution.test.ts passes
bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferCommit.test.ts passes
bun run build passes

userStories.title: Reuse or materialize imported snapshots during commit
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want commit-time provider and model writes to reuse imported snapshots by fingerprint or materialize new ones so that repeated imports stay stable without remapping to local rows.
acceptanceCriteria: Commit reuses exact-match imported provider and model snapshot ids chosen during analysis and materializes new snapshot rows only for the remaining virtual ids.
Imported provider rows keep `secretRef = null`, and reused or newly materialized imported provider/model snapshot rows end disabled after import.
Importing the same package twice reuses the same imported snapshots by marker and fingerprint rather than creating duplicates.
bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferCommit.test.ts passes
bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferDependencyResolution.test.ts passes
bun run build passes

userStories.title: Add raw provenance mode controls to the export UI
userStories.description: As a project transfer operator, I want to choose raw provenance mode from the export UI so that the browser and desktop flows use the intended export behavior without manual API calls.
acceptanceCriteria: The export action UI exposes raw provenance mode choices for project export with `auto` as the default.
The selected mode is sent in the export start request for both inline downloads and queued export sessions.
Adding the selector does not break the existing CSV export action or block the surrounding project list shell.
bun test src/components/main/projectsGrid.vitest.tsx passes
bun run build passes
bun run desktop:build passes
Verify in browser that project export can be started with each raw provenance mode

userStories.title: Choose a stronger policy for remaining decision-bearing omissions
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want remaining decision-bearing omission cases to fail loudly or warn prominently so that partial exports are never mistaken for clean fidelity-preserving packages.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement one consistent policy for remaining decision-bearing parent omissions after URL preservation changes: explicit export blocking or a high-visibility preflight fidelity warning before package finalization.
The policy applies consistently across article, prompt, judgment, human judgment, human summary, and review omission paths.
Tests prevent quiet continuation of partial exports when decision-bearing rows are omitted for non-URL reasons.
bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferExport.test.ts passes
bun test src/server/services/projectTransfer/projectTransferRedaction.test.ts passes
bun run build passes

userStories.title: Render richer omission warnings in the import UI
userStories.description: As a project transfer operator, I want the import wizard to show source row and field context for omission warnings so that I can understand package fidelity issues without reading server code.
acceptanceCriteria: The import wizard surfaces omission-warning context such as source row id, field name, and dependency reason when that detail is present.
Warnings that are truly identical still group cleanly, while warnings with distinct row or field context remain distinguishable in the rendered UI.
The browser and desktop import flows continue to render the wizard shell correctly while showing the richer warning information.
bun test src/app/routes/+projects/-+import.vitest.tsx passes
bun run build passes
bun run desktop:build passes
Verify in browser that the import wizard shows richer omission warnings without losing the existing shell layout
